source.material: Three adult friends sit at a café table. One recounts mixing up two measurements while baking a cake, and another reacts to how the dessert unexpectedly turned out. The third friend stays with the gathering and nobody enters, leaves, or changes seats.

source_abstraction.premise: Three companions seated around a café table share an amusing anecdote about a cooking mistake without anyone leaving or shifting positions.
source_abstraction.interaction_arc: One companion begins recounting a kitchen mishap involving swapped ingredients, a second companion reacts with surprise and amusement to the unexpected result, and the third companion attentively takes in the humorous exchange as the shared laughter subsides.

subjects.appearance: Mustard yellow knit sweater and a high messy bun.
Navy blue denim jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses.
Forest green turtleneck and cropped silver-streaked hair.

shots.beat: A leans forward over the tabletop, using animated hand gestures to recount a tale about a recipe blunder. B adjusts round wire-rimmed glasses while smiling with amusement, and C holds a warm mug with both hands while nodding along attentively.
A pantomimes the sudden moment of pouring salt instead of sugar, shaking head in dramatic disbelief. B covers mouth with one hand while leaning back slightly, chuckling at the revelation.
A gives a wide shrug and lets out a quiet laugh while picking up a small teaspoon. B rests both forearms against the table, nodding along as the laughter settles.

shots.content: In a quiet café seating area, a rectangular wooden table sits parallel to a window, with a tall floor plant standing directly behind the table's plant-side short end, the café counter beyond the opposite short end, and an open aisle running along the side opposite the window with no other people nearby. In the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant, a person in a mustard yellow knit sweater with a high messy bun leans forward over the tabletop, using animated hand gestures to recount a recipe blunder. In the window-side seat nearest the café counter, a person in a navy blue denim jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses adjusts the glasses while smiling with amusement. At the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, a person in a forest green turtleneck with cropped silver-streaked hair holds a warm mug with both hands while nodding along attentively.

The person in the mustard yellow knit sweater and high messy bun pantomimes the sudden moment of pouring salt instead of sugar, shaking their head in dramatic disbelief. The person in the navy blue denim jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses covers their mouth with one hand while leaning back slightly, chuckling at the revelation.

The person in the mustard yellow knit sweater and high messy bun gives a wide shrug and lets out a quiet laugh while picking up a small teaspoon. Nearby, the person in the navy blue denim jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses rests both forearms against the table, nodding along as the laughter settles.
